description: Monotonicity / TVD gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 test tvd_monotone of problems/advection_1d_periodic_superbee.esm (model AdvectionSuperbeeTVD) at the default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The tent profile is advected at c=1; the assertions bound the state's max (no overshoot), min (no undershoot), and mean (exact conservation) — the sim-expressible form of the TVD claim. Assertions and tolerances live in the problem file; this manifest routes runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust TERMINATES at this manifest's own tolerance (Erk 1e-10/1e-12, ~22 s) as of EarthSciAST dc76c5bf and passes its inline assertions: the whole-array overlay retired the hang, so 'hangs at every tolerance tried' is no longer true. It stays out of Rust scope for a DIFFERENT, measured reason: the actual is outside the 1e-9 cross-binding-actuals floor vs the Julia (Tsit5) reference -- tvd_monotone[3] 0.9277577578671593 vs 0.9277577947155905, 4.0e-8 relative. Reproduced bit-identically across two independent runs, so this is a deterministic Erk-vs-Tsit5 method-disagreement floor, not flakiness and not a discretization error. MEASURED 2026-07-28 against EarthSciAST dc76c5bf via scripts/runners/run-rust.sh. Re-arm when both bindings run the same integrator, or when SIM_CROSS_RTOL in scripts/compare-outputs.py admits solver-method disagreement -- the sibling cases advection_2d_x_zero_grad_central and advection_2d_y_zero_grad_central are excluded for exactly this reason and nothing else.

python._doc: Deterministic LSODA/RK45-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: tvd_monotone[3] rel 1.27e-07 / abs 1.18e-07 (ref 9.277578e-01). MEASURED from CI run 33272496703 (2026-08-29); the values are bit-stable across runs and the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
